hidden_test_cmd: sh -c 'PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" exec python -m pytest -q -p no:subtests "$@"' sh tests/hidden
tests_may_change_note: The fixture file tests/fixtures/optimizer/simplify.sql, which a correct fix must update in six places, is not test code. The simplify test methods are listed because a fix may add direct cases to them.

open_decision.what: What happens to COALESCE arguments that come after one that can never be NULL (a non-NULL literal). S1 says it is not decided.
open_decision.owner_answer: Drop them: nothing after a non-NULL constant can ever be reached. COALESCE(x, 0, y) becomes COALESCE(x, 0); COALESCE(NULL, 0, y) becomes 0.
open_decision.obvious_default: Leave them: the ticket is about NULL arguments, and the existing opt-in rule only collapses a COALESCE whose first argument is a constant.

naive_patches.naive.patch: the obvious default: drops NULL arguments only, keeps everything after a non-NULL constant
